From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Pilot consumption roadmap + safety-net credits

Hi Sam / Priya — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick follow-up with a concise consumption checklist so we can lock pilot economics and confirm next steps.

Recap of what we heard (please correct if I missed anything):
- Target workload: multi-turn conversational FAQs + summarization on 1.2–1.8M monthly end-user sessions; estimate ~20–35M input+output tokens/month during pilot.
- SLOs: 95% requests < 300ms P95 for short requests, burst support for peak shopping hours.
- Primary success metric: stable latency under load and ability to stay under target unit cost.

Budget/Unit economics we discussed:
- Target blended unit price goal: ~$900 per 1M tokens (target $/1M tokens to meet internal cost constraints).
- Pilot budget range: $25k–$60k total spend for the 8-week pilot window (customer indicated preference toward the $40k mid-point).

Credit & trial ask:
- You requested an extra safety net (credits) in case initial traffic spikes burn the pilot faster than expected.
- Proposed Redwood safety-net: 75,000 free tokens-equivalent credits (applied as consumption credit) + one 2-week trial extension if we hit the first-month burn threshold.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm expected average daily tokens for the first 30 days (low/likely/high)? That will let us size the credit cadence.
2) Please confirm the internal budget owner and PO lead so we can add the correct approver on the DocuSign amendment.
3) We suggest a 30-minute check-in at the 2-week mark to review burn and routing rules — are mornings PST better?

Attachments: RG-pilot-consumption-plan.xlsx (consumption scenarios + unit-price sensitivity).

Thanks — I'm looping Marissa (CS lead) and Aditya (finops) for quick approval flow.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RG-pilot-consumption-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 36 KB)]

Thanks, Irene — this is helpful. Quick clarifications:
- Our initial rollout will be to a subset of customers (Phase 1), so expected daily tokens look like: low 0.6M / likely 1.0M / high 1.6M (so ~18–48M/month depending on usage patterns).
- Budget owner is Priya (cc'd) and procurement lead is Rajesh Mehta (rajesh@retailgrid.com).
- The $900/1M target aligns with our internal finance guardrails; $40k for the 8-week pilot is what we were expecting.

Two asks from our side:
1) Could Redwood increase credits to 100,000 token-equivalent if the high-case daily traffic happens in week 1? We want a buffer to avoid throttles while we tune prefix caching.
2) Please include a link to SOC 2 evidence and the standard data retention policy in the DocuSign amendment so our security team can pre-approve.

We can do the 2-week check-in; mornings PST are best for our team.

—Sam
